name: UGC / Social Realism
visual_style: Authentic smartphone-style footage with realistic skin, informal home or outdoor setting and modest imperfections.
camera: Handheld phone perspective at eye level with subtle natural shake.
lighting: Window light or believable everyday practical lighting.
motion: Casual real-time gestures and natural conversation-like movement.
consistency: Same creator, outfit and room across all scenes.
negative_guidance: Polished studio look, perfect skin, staged framing, text, captions, logos or watermarks inside the image (on-screen text is added in HyperFrames).

video.palette: Natural phone colors with bright caption highlights
video.pacing: Fast hook in the first second, quick cuts
video.voice_tone: Casual, authentic creator talking to camera
